## A form (in the page)

- **`Your Zip Code` / `Enter your Zip Code...` / `zipCode`**: `text field`. In `FindAnAgentElements` as `YOUR_ZIP_CODE_INPUT`: `enter().yourZipCode(...)`.
- **`Search by Zip Code`**: `button`. In `FindAnAgentElements` as `SEARCH_BY_ZIP_CODE_BUTTON`: `click().searchByZipCode()`.
- **`Use My Current Location`**: `button`. In `FindAnAgentElements` as `USE_MY_CURRENT_LOCATION_BUTTON`: `click().useMyCurrentLocation()`.
